These features need the herald-push plugin on your gateway: %1$s. If it isn’t there yet, Herald installs version %2$s from %3$s, at the commit this Herald was reviewed with. %4$s Updates are only installed when you choose to, and you can remove the plugin on the gateway at any time.

Herald installs Next Prompt %1$s, a community plugin, from %2$s, at the commit this Herald was reviewed with. After every turn, in Herald, Desktop and the terminal alike, it sends the last few messages of the chat to your model (or the one set for its auxiliary task) and keeps the reply it suggests. That’s one more model call per turn. You can remove it on the gateway at any time.
It watches your bots’ chats and sends each new reply to this phone, end-to-end encrypted through ntfy.sh.

Herald updates older herald-push copies on the gateway and its bot profiles to %1$s from %2$s, at the commit this Herald was reviewed with. Disabled copies stay disabled. Running chats gain new tools when their agent session reloads.
Updates are only installed when you choose to.
